title: record_evidence result
description: A quote that matches no ANSWER turn is rejected with accepted:false, which is how fabricated quotes are caught. Matching is normalised (lowercased, punctuation stripped, whitespace collapsed) and similarity-based, not literal containment: strict containment over-rejects because STT punctuation varies and models near-quote rather than quote.

evidenceId.description: Null when rejected. Stable for a repeated (competency, quote) pair, which makes the tool effectively idempotent.

matchedTurnSeq.description: Sequence number of the ANSWER turn the quote was matched against. Null when rejected.

similarity.description: Best normalised similarity found against any ANSWER turn. Null when there were no answer turns to compare against.

reason.description: Why the quote was rejected. Null when accepted is true.
